messages:
Sara (Partnerships): quick sync: Conductor adapter for LangChain/LlamaIndex -> Redwood Gateway. Pilot app is running on their side. Need: security review, marketplace listing assets, joint blog + demo date. Who's owning what?

Matt (DevEx): I merged the initial adapter branch. Repo: https://github.com/conductor/redwood-adapter. Smoke tests local ✅. Sample init:
```
from conductor_adapter import ConductorClient
c = ConductorClient(api_key="REDACTED", gateway_url="https://gateway.redwood.ai")
```
Supports streaming + function-calling?

Jiwon (Eng-Platform): quick check: gateway routing needs the adapter to expose capability metadata (json schema) so we can map to model variants. Also need helm values for Dedicated. I'll post chart snippet later.

Anand (Security): put together security checklist: 1) SSO + SCIM support 2) KMS flow for keys 3) data residency doc 4) pen test report or plan. Need docs & sample infra by EOD Fri to fast-track.

Matt (DevEx): adapter currently uses API key auth; Conductor team said they can add token exchange. I'll coordinate. Function-calling yes, streaming yes (tested with chatstreams).

Nick (Marketing): proposed timeline: announcement blog + demo at Partner Summit. Need logo, 60s explainer video, 2 screenshots, and 1 production customer quote (if available). Can we target Nov 9?

Sara (Partnerships): Nov 9 sounds ok if security signoff by Nov 1 and we have assets by Nov 3. Action items: Matt -> finalize token-exchange; Jiwon -> helm + routing metadata; Anand -> security checklist owner; Nick -> draft assets request.

deploy-bot: integration-tests/adapter-check passed on conductor/adapter—CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4521 ✅

Matt (DevEx): uploaded quickstart gist: https://gist.github.com/matt/adapter-quickstart. Also added a small example for LangChain:
```
from langchain import LLMChain
from conductor_adapter import RedwoodGatewayLLM
llm = RedwoodGatewayLLM(gateway_url="https://gateway.redwood.ai", model="gpt-like")
```

Jiwon (Eng-Platform): noted. I'll add a compatibility doc for Dedicated + Private (limits & quantization profiles). ETA Tue.

Anand (Security): starting threat model today. Ping me @sara when Matt has token-exchange PR so I can review.

Sara (Partnerships): thanks — scheduling 30m check-in Thu 10am PT. If anything blocks earlier call me. :tada:
